objective: Locate frozen Stage1 0bp SOXX underperformance across every year, quarter, contiguous 126-session window and the previously fixed decision-time 5/20-day SOXX sign regimes; compare weak and strong intervals without selecting a trading rule.
regime_rule: Reuse src.analysis.regime_failure.regime_features: only prior signal-day SOXX return5/return20 signs, zero boundary fixed, all four groups retained and feature_available_at < decision_at required.
window_rule: All 944 matched funded intervals; year and quarter by trade_date to match the frozen Stage1 period sidecars, partial endpoints separately; all 819 contiguous 126-session windows from the frozen Recorder. The decision-time regime uses the prior signal-day 5/20-day signs.
analysis: Daily paired log excess, regime and quarter sum, mean filled cash/SOXL weight, nonzero risk-state fraction, executed opening fraction, and existing complete-year/rolling gates. These are descriptive path statistics, not isolated risk-control or feature effects.
stops: Any source hash, calendar, cost, identity, decision-time or published aggregate reconciliation mismatch stops before interpretation.
Do not select a feature, sign, window, threshold or account from the weakest observed cell.
Keep the source Recorder and all closed fixed experiments unchanged.
